CommunityApplications.Profile: FejesNAS utilities for Unraid 7. Fejes Mover Monitor offers Hungarian, US English and German Mover/cache monitoring, waiting-file explanations and optional guarded native movement in the documented reviewed setup. Observer is the default; installation starts no movement and creates no schedule. Stable build 2026.11.14.3 includes managed-scheduler recovery acceptance on an isolated Unraid 7.3.4 VM. The previous build includes verified full-runner movement and isolated peer-transfer evidence. Reboot recovery and compatibility limits are documented on GitHub.
